'''Irrational Number''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] at [[Jugsmuk Station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. It was owned and operated by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] known as "[[Numbers (Bith)|Numbers]]." The Irrational Number was busy but well organized, and allowed patrons to drink and [[Gambling/Legends|gamble]]. Rooms were available for rent, and Numbers had an [[Mark 16 Enzymer]] console on the premises.<ref name="MS" />
